PP_CommandsIntro: Actions you trigger with the controller buttons. Here you can see what each one does, which buttons trigger it and where to set it up.
PP_CmdPowerOffDesc: Turns off at once the controller that presses the combo (Bluetooth). While you press it, the game does not receive those buttons. By USB cable it cannot be turned off: unplug the cable.
PP_CmdPowerOffWhere: Works for every controller. Choose the buttons here.
PP_CmdGyroDesc: While you hold L2, tilting the controller moves the aim. Release L2 and it stops. It pauses in racing games if you choose so.
PP_CmdGyroWhere: Turn it on in Controllers → Controller settings (on each controller).
PP_CmdAimSensDesc: Changes how fast the right stick turns while you aim and while you aim and shoot. It never moves the aim on its own.
PP_CmdAimSensWhere: Turn it on in Games → each game (off by default).
